All tests pass.

🟢 Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation** (`/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_00-13-47_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking-3/src/claim-office.ts`):
1. Added `amulet: 600` to `INSURANCE_VALUE_BY_ITEM_TYPE` — the previous `NaN` came from the lookup miss for the amulet in the policy (1000 + 600 = 1600 insurance sum, cap 3200).
2. Changed `claimResultFor` from destructuring only the first damage entry to reducing over all entries, so each damage entry gets its own deductible: (500 − 100) + (300 − 100) = 600, remaining cap 3200 − 600 = 2600.

**Result**: All tests now pass (31 passing, 18 todo)

**Approach**: This is minimal — the reduce reuses the existing `payoutForDamage` helper and only generalizes from "first damage" to "all damages", which is exactly what the current test forces. The single new constant is the one lookup value the test data demands; no other item types, no cap clamping, no rounding, no special clauses were added even though later `it.todo()` tests will need them.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
